data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns before expenses that closely correspond to the total returns of the Nifty Midcap150 Momentum 50 Index subject to tracking errors. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized and the Scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
data.asset_allocation:
1. Equity and equity related securities constituting the Nifty Midcap150 Momentum 50 Index - 95-100%
2. Debt and Money Market Instruments - 0-5%
data.benchmark: Nifty Midcap150 Momentum 50 Index Total Return Index
data.exit_load:
• If the units are redeemed / switched out on or before 30 days from the date of allotment – 0.50%.  
• If the units are redeemed / switched out after 30 days from the date of allotment – Nil
